messages.subject: Employment law update seminar - 24 April
messages.plaintextBody:
A reminder that the quarterly Employment Law Update (case-law round-up, including recent EAT decisions on whistleblowing detriment) is on Thursday 24 April, 12:30-14:00 in the Bishopsgate training room. Lunch provided. Please reply to reserve a place - counts towards your CPD hours.

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant
